```plato

//==
// # Stroke styling
//
// The geometry side of painting a path: caps, joins, alignment, dash
// patterns, the complete stroke description, the markers stamped along a
// stroked path, and the parameter records for turning a stroke or a dash into
// concrete path geometry. Consumes Path2D from `paths.types.plato`; the paint side
// is the section above.

// The shape a stroke takes at the open end of a contour: flat at the
// endpoint (Butt), a semicircular cap (Round), or flat but extended past the
// endpoint by half the stroke width (Square).
type LineCap = Butt | Round | Square;
```
